exa.description: Exa web search (web_search_exa), page reading as markdown (web_fetch_exa) and multi-step research (agent_run, metered). Signed in to the owner's Exa account.

firecrawl.description: Firecrawl web scraping and crawling: read one page, search, or crawl and map a whole site. Signed in to the owner's Firecrawl account.

beacon.description: Read and change Beacon (the owner's productivity app on this Mac): tasks, habits, events, Calendar.app, books, finances, Screen Time and notes. Call beacon_get_context first.

hark.description: Hark personal assistant (unofficial API): read/send conversations, wait for replies, answer asks
